[[File:NapalmStrikeIcon.png|20px|Napalm Strike]][[Napalm Strike]] |sandbox = No |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|Fire.png|No Burn}} }} ==Description== '''Burn Immunity''' (with its tag referring to it as "''No Burn''") is an immunity that prevents the enemy from being set on fire. ==Mechanics== '''Burn Immunity''' prevents the enemy from being set on fire. This includes, but is not limited to, the [[Pyromancer]], [[Golden Pyromancer]], fire bomb [[Jester]], Level 3+ [[Archer]], [[Trapper]]'s landmines, [[Molotov]] and [[Napalm Strike]]. These towers/consumables can still deal non-burn damage to these enemies in most cases, however, they cannot deal burn damage to them. There is one exception to this, that being the [[Napalm Strike]]. The fire created on the path will not deal damage to any enemies with the '''Burn Immunity'''. Additionally, as burn defense dropping drops defense through burn, these enemies cannot have their defense dropped by it. The following towers/consumables become unable to apply these burn effects to '''Burn Immune''' enemies: *[[Pyromancer]] *[[Trapper]] *[[Archer]] *[[Jester]] *[[Hallow Punk]] *[[Elementalist]] *[[Firework Technician]] *[[Spotlight Tech]] *[[Molotov]] *[[Napalm Strike]] *[[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monster]] *[[Ducky Squad]] ([[Fire Ducky]]) *[[Heatwave]] *[[Unholy Storm]] Prior to the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], '''Burn Immunity''' made it so that the [[Pyromancer]] cannot attack these enemies. Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], this immunity prevented the [[Pyromancer]] from slowing down enemies, as it did so through its burn effect. As it got removed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], this no longer occurs. In the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], '''Burn Immunity''' was added to all [[Boss]] enemies, making them immune to its slowdown. As the [[Pyromancer]]'s slowdown was removed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], '''Burn Immunity''' was also removed from [[Boss]] enemies, with some exceptions like the [[Molten Boss]].
